lockFileMaintenance.description: Workspace builds use --locked, so a stale Cargo.lock is a build input like any other; refresh it on the same monthly cadence.

git-submodules.description: content/ is a deliberately pinned game-data submodule, not a dependency to track.

packageRules.description: The whole workspace shares one Cargo.lock, so separate compatible-update pull requests would each invalidate the others. Collect them into one.
Workflow action bumps are independent of the Rust build; keep them in their own pull request.

This engine is held to bit-for-bit parity with the C++ oracle and its CI is currently disabled, so a major bump must not open unreviewed. Tick it on the dependency dashboard to request the pull request.
